judged_text: evt.destinationCalendar is initialized to null (not []) when neither eventType nor organizer has a destination calendar, making the subsequent `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` a no-op that silently discards every teammate's collected destination calendar. A COLLECTIVE booking whose organizer has no destination calendar drops all teammates' destinationCalendars — their configured destination calendars are ignored and their events land on default calendars via the create-on-all-credentials branch instead of the calendars they configured.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, silently discarding the collected teammates’ destination calendars. Downstream, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates destinations when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; otherwise it falls back to the default branch, consistent with the described misrouting to default calendars.
